paragraphs.text: Nikara is a Human Cleric from Ikoria . She is bonded with the giant Hyena Beast Yannik .

Nikara and Yannik are both outsiders and loners, misunderstood by their home communities. They are bonded only to each other, and they rely on their companionship to help them survive Ikoria's harsh, monster-riddled wilderness. From their point of view, there are few you can trust to have your back — but the ones you can, you do without hesitation.
